capabilities: Highlight Cisco IOS, IOS-XE, IOS-XR and NX-OS configs in fenced code blocks
Tokenize Cisco-specific syntax such as comments, interfaces, IP/MAC addresses and secrets
Apply theme-aware or fixed Vibrant color schemes that adapt to light and dark
Configure Live Preview highlighting, bold keywords and color scheme in settings
disambiguation: Not a network device manager; it only adds syntax highlighting for Cisco configs in code blocks.
extras: At profile time it is not yet in the community catalog and must be installed manually; secret highlighting colors values only and does not hide or encrypt them. A roadmap lists FortiOS support, section folding, and autocomplete.
problem: Obsidian's code block highlighting does not include Cisco network configuration dialects, so IOS configs render as plain uncolored text.
summary: Syntax highlighter that colorizes Cisco IOS, IOS-XE, IOS-XR and NX-OS configuration inside cisco-tagged fenced code blocks in Reading mode and Live Preview.
